title: Pattaya Gym Directory — Recently Added
description: Latest verified gyms, Muay Thai camps, dive operators, golf courses and sport venues added to the Pattaya Gym Directory.

items.title: Petchrungruang Gym
items.content_text: Family Muay Thai camp in South Pattaya offering group training for different experience levels.

items.title: Venum Training Camp Thailand
items.content_text: Soi Khopai combat-sports camp with Muay Thai, boxing, MMA, BJJ and cross-training.

items.title: ALFA BJJ Pattaya
items.content_text: Closed former BJJ academy whose owner page directed followers to the instructor’s current BJJ updates.

items.title: Rage Fight Academy
items.content_text: South Pattaya combat camp with Muay Thai, boxing, BJJ, MMA, functional training, accommodation and a pool.

items.title: Tony's Fitness Group
items.content_text: South Pattaya Third Road weight-training gym with round-the-clock listing hours.

items.title: Platinum Fitness Club
items.content_text: Legacy record retained for identity tracking; current Pattaya operation could not be verified.

items.title: Coco Fitness
items.content_text: Fourth-floor Mike Shopping Mall gym with owner-published July 2026 memberships from ฿1,599 for one month and a 1,000+ sqm training floor.

items.title: Universe Gym
items.content_text: Active Welcome Town fitness and bodybuilding gym with a contact-first tariff.

items.title: Jetts Fitness Little Walk Pattaya
items.content_text: Jetts club at Little Walk Pattaya with 24-hour member access and published staffed hours.

items.title: Anytime Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: One record covering separate Again Pattaya and Bukis Point clubs; both list 24-hour access, while the operator facility inventory belongs to Bukit Point.

items.title: True Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: Legacy record retained for identity tracking; no current Pattaya operation could be verified.

items.title: SUN Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: Three-branch Pattaya fitness group whose operator pages confirm one-card member access across Buakhao, Pratamnak and Naklua.

items.title: Yoga Haus Pattaya
items.content_text: Unverified legacy yoga listing: an exact current Maps place and a current operator identity could not be confirmed on 26 July 2026.

items.title: Nok Yoga
items.content_text: Active Nong Prue yoga page offering health-focused and therapeutic movement instruction; book directly for the current schedule.

items.title: Burapha Golf Club
items.content_text: Operating 36-hole golf complex in Bo Win, Si Racha.

items.title: Khao Kheow Country Club
items.content_text: Active Bang Phra golf club with daily hours and current society play, but no dependable first-hand visitor tariff.

items.title: Bangpra Golf Club
items.content_text: Bang Phra 18-hole, par-72 golf course with a dated 28–29 July 2026 inclusive package.

items.title: Mountain Shadow Golf Club
items.content_text: Operating 18-hole, par-72 golf course in Mueang Chonburi, north of Pattaya.

items.title: Pattaya Golf Driving Range
items.content_text: Active North Pattaya practice range with daily Maps hours and a Pattaya Sports Club member price for 55 balls.

items.title: Greta Sport Club Pattaya
items.content_text: Na Jomtien tennis and beach-tennis venue with current 2026 federation event use.

items.title: Tara Tennis Pattaya
items.content_text: East Pattaya indoor court facility for tennis, pickleball and basketball, open daily from early morning to late evening.

items.title: TOS Tennis Academy
items.content_text: Chaiyapruek Road tennis academy with coaching for varied ages and levels.

items.title: Siam Bayshore Pattaya Tennis Courts
items.content_text: Six daytime tennis courts open to hotel guests and the public at Siam Bayshore Pattaya.

items.title: Diamond Badminton
items.content_text: Closed badminton venue: the exact Google Maps listing showed permanently closed on 26 July 2026, with no current owner reopening source found.

items.title: Play Padel Pattaya
items.content_text: Indoor Pratamnak padel arena with daily hours, courts at ฿1,200 per hour and private coaching from ฿600 per hour.

items.title: BOUNCE Pattaya
items.content_text: No current BOUNCE venue in Pattaya could be verified; the Harbor listing is JUMPZ and is permanently closed.
